title: DialCache shared replay protocol v1
description: One JSON object per line. Prepare retains all expected state in the coordinator. Native drivers apply setup, then observe index 0. Apply every returned input in order, settling causally ready work after each. Do not advance a future timer or release a held gate to settle. Journals preserve invocation identity and observed order; no expected field controls scheduling. Profile-specific observation projection is defined in adjacent shared modules. Completion acknowledges the entire trace only.

observed.description: The driver's complete current observation, encoded per profile: $defs/behaviorObservation for every feature profile and for effects, $defs/coreObservation for core, $defs/localClockObservation for local-clock. The prepare result names the session's definition in `observation`; ports should validate each record against that definition locally before sending it, so a shape defect is attributed to the driver without a coordinator round trip. The coordinator validates it again before any comparison and reports a violation as 'Malformed replay observation: <definition> at <path>', so a shape error is an infrastructure failure, never an observation mismatch.

wallMs.description: The driver's actual wall clock in epoch milliseconds when this observation was taken. Behavior, effects and core drivers start their controlled wall clock at 2026-09-08T12:00:00.000Z (1788868800000 ms) and move it only through advance, shiftWall and advanceWall commands; frame timestamps and marker cutoffs are computed relative to that epoch. The local-clock driver reports its real process clock, which no mapping consumes.

observation.description: The $defs definition every observation of this session must satisfy: behaviorObservation for feature profiles and effects, coreObservation for core, localClockObservation for local-clock. Ports validate each observed record against it locally before sending.

ageMs.description: Frame age at seed time in whole milliseconds; negative ages stamp a future frame.

ttlMs.description: Redis TTL of the seeded frame in whole milliseconds. Default 60000.

futureBufferMs.description: Watermark future buffer in whole milliseconds. Default 0.

value.description: Explicit runtime configuration input, including deliberately malformed values in boundary profiles. Omitted fields, null, false and zero are distinct.

policy.description: Explicit runtime configuration input, including deliberately malformed values in boundary profiles. Omitted fields, null, false and zero are distinct.

primitive.description: Metric label or diagnostic detail. Labels never carry nested records; a strongly typed port can keep its own label struct and serialize it flat.

absent.description: A call that completed without a value (TypeScript undefined, Go zero value with no payload). Distinct from null.

callResult.description: Outcome of one begun getOrLoad call, in begin order. Error identities are driver-local indices, never messages: source:N is the N-th controlled source failure, timeout:N the N-th fallback deadline error, unexpected:<text> anything else.

observedEvent.description: One journal entry recorded only when the fixture's observe list names its kind. Metric events carry the observer's flat labels; readContext, readAbort, writeDispatch and marker are driver-side environment probes. Order is the driver's actual callback order.

index.description: Zero-based remote read index, equal to reads before this read started.

timeoutMs.description: Remote read budget handed to the adapter.

oneOf.description: Maintenance metrics carry no use case.

seconds.description: Duration or age in seconds as reported to the metrics observer.

oneOf.description: Details object of the shadow validation mismatch warning log. Value previews are present only when the policy enables mismatch logging with details.

index.description: Zero-based remote write index, equal to writes before this write started.

oneOf.description: Controlled Redis environment probe, never DialCache internal state.

cutoffMs.description: Invalidation watermark relative to the fixed wall epoch, or -1 when no watermark exists.

ttlMs.description: Remaining watermark TTL in the controlled Redis environment; negative sentinels follow the driver's Redis fake.

behaviorObservation.description: Observation of the behavior driver used by every feature profile and by effects. Counters count started effects, including held ones. Lists preserve observed order.

events.description: Present exactly when the fixture declares an observe list.

maintenance.description: Outcome of each invalidateRemote command in order.

sourceScopes.description: isEnabled() observed inside each source invocation when the fixture probes source scope.

writeTtls.description: cacheTtlMs of each remote write request in dispatch order.

coreObservation.description: Flat integer observation of the core conformance driver.

localClockObservation.description: Behavior-shaped observation of the local-clock driver: calls are the plain integers returned by each call, loaders counts source invocations, every other counter stays zero and every other list stays empty. No events key.

maintenance.description: Outcome of each invalidateRemote command in order.

sourceScopes.description: isEnabled() observed inside each source invocation when the fixture probes source scope.

writeTtls.description: cacheTtlMs of each remote write request in dispatch order.

behaviorFixture.description: Construction-time configuration of the behavior driver. Omitted fields take the driver default named in each description; sentinel strings select the library default instead of the driver default.

localFaultInjection.description: Bind the model's fallible local-storage boundary to a controlled exception hook.

policy.description: Default key configuration passed to every call. Explicit runtime configuration input; omitted fields, null, false and zero are distinct.

tracked.description: trackForInvalidation for every call and seed. Default false.

fallbackTimeoutMs.description: Source deadline. Omitted: 10 ms. null: no deadline. "default": leave the library default in place.

readTimeoutMs.description: Remote read timeout. Omitted: 50 ms. "default": leave the library default in place.

localMaxSize.description: Local cache capacity. Omitted: library default.

shadowMaxInFlight.description: Shadow validation concurrency. Omitted: library default.

recovery.description: Instance-wide stale recovery classifier: allow/deny return that verdict and count a classification, error throws. Omitted or "default": no instance classifier.

comparator.description: Per-call shadow comparator verdict; each invocation counts a comparison. Omitted: library comparator.

comparisonMs.description: Elapsed wall time consumed inside each comparator invocation without delivering timers.

sourceWorkMs.description: Elapsed wall time consumed inside each source invocation without delivering timers.

shadowHook.description: false removes the shadowValidation metrics hook. Default true.

observerFailure.description: Every observer and logger callback throws. Default false.

remote.description: false constructs the cache without a Redis client. Default true.

probeSourceScope.description: Record isEnabled() inside each source invocation into sourceScopes.

observe.description: Event kinds journaled into observation.events. Its presence, even empty, makes events required in every observation.

emptyFixture.description: Core and local-clock drivers take no construction-time fixture.

fixture.description: Fixture returned by prepare. Feature profiles and effects return a behaviorFixture; core and local-clock return an empty object.
